section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses a single study that aimed to assess the factor structure and psychometric properties of an Arabic-translated version of the BAS-2. The study, conducted in the UAE, used a convenience sample of young adult women attending a university. It found a one-dimensional factor structure for the BAS-2 and evidence of internal consistency and convergent validity, noting a negative but non-significant correlation between body appreciation and BMI. Limitations included the specific sample profile and reliance on self-reported BMI data.
